'''Imperial Outpost Aurek-Two''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] facility active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Neil Barani]] contacted Imperial Outpost Aurek Two, requesting contact with the [[Imperial Resource Procurement Bureau]] after finding [[Doonium/Legends|doonium]] at the [[Yen-2]] mining colony.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
